exit 0
--- stdout
a redirect's cookie reaches the next hop:
  200 cookie=sid=abc
a final response's cookie is kept:
  200 set
later requests carry both:
  200 cookie=sid=abc; theme=dark
after the request's own Cookie field:
  200 cookie=own=1; sid=abc; theme=dark
a client without a jar sends none:
  200 cookie=-
a store of the program's own:
  200 cookie=sid=abc
  its calls: 3
--- stderr
